security_ceiling: The encrypted browser vault hardens secret material at rest but does not protect an unlocked origin against XSS or malicious same-origin script.
A fully compromised browser profile, device, or operating system remains outside the protection ceiling.
Browser storage can be cleared or evicted according to browser/device policy; persistent-storage requests are best-effort.
Playwright WebKit is engine-class browser evidence, not physical iPadOS Safari evidence.
